messages:
sara: Hey team — putting up a request for regional capacity in asia-south1 for the EdgeServices rollout next month. Need GPUs for inference: 8x A100 (80GB) and 12x L4. Project: `redwood-edge-prod`. Planned start: 2026-04-15. Can someone advise on the quickest path for quota approval and any network preflight we should do? @mike @alex-oncall

mike: Thanks — a few quick Qs: 1) is this bursty (short-term) or sustained? 2) approx vCPU / memory per node? 3) do you need reserved external IPs / egress rules? If you can paste the exact quota names I’ll start the GCP request. Also please fill the internal quota form: https://go/redwood-gcp-quota-form (one-line summary + cost center).

sara: Mostly sustained for 6 months with occasional spikes for nightly retraining. Node config: we’ll run 1 A100 per pod, batching enabled; L4s used for lower-priority preview instances. Yes need 4 static egress IPs (NAT) and VPC peering with `prod-data` VPC. Estimated monthly incremental spend: ~$35k (GPU hours + egress). I added the one-line to the form just now.

alex-oncall: Quick note: if we expand asia-south1 pool we should make sure autoscaler policies don’t starve other prod pools. Can we do soft limits (burstable) first and ramp to reserved after validation? :eyes:

mike: Agreed — I'll request an initial quota bump for: "GPUS (nvidia-a100)" => +8 and "GPUS (nvidia-l4)" => +12, plus "Static External IPs" => +4. I’ll mark them as burstable in the ticket notes. Please confirm project billing account: `billing-redwood-prod` and cost center `AI-EDGE`.

sara: Confirmed billing account and cost center. Also note we need IAM: service account `edge-infer-sa@redwood-edge-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` to be granted `compute.viewer` and `serviceusage.serviceUsageConsumer` before quota grant, per the preflight checklist.

olivia: Go ahead and submit. Approving the request from product side — tag me if they ask for additional justification.

raj (finance): Throwing a flag on the estimate — can we get a 90-day forecast with per-region cost split? If sustained, we should consider reserved commitments or committed use discounts. I can model it if you send the expected utilization curve.

mike: Putting the request in now. Checklist: 1) internal form done 2) billing confirmed 3) IAM service account confirmed 4) network requirements (NAT + peering) noted. Sample command / snippets for ops when quotas land:
```bash
# verify region and quotas
gcloud compute regions describe asia-south1 --project=redwood-edge-prod
# list current gpu quotas
gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-edge-prod --format="json(quotas)" | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric|test("GPUS"))'
```
I'll request ticket Q-2026-4521 with GCP support and mark it as "priority:high".

quota-bot: Ticket created: Q-2026-4521. Status: pending GCP review. ETA 48-72 hours. Uploaded attachments: internal-form.pdf, cost-estimate.xlsx.

sara: Awesome — thanks Mike. I’ll coordinate the network preflight with infra-network and schedule a short blackout window for the initial drop-in testing.

alex-oncall: When ticket is approved, pls @alex-oncall so we can watch scaling events and ensure we don’t trigger cross-region fallbacks.

mike: Will do. Closing loop once GCP responds. :white_check_mark:
